# === Run 6 — sdh-spot-check, electron side: n = +3.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 0 -> 10 T ===
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

r6 = run(6)
_o = np.argsort(r6.col("magnet_field"))
B6 = r6.col("magnet_field")[_o]
I6 = (r6.col("sr0_X") / r6.metadata["measurement_config"]["sr0_gain"])[_o]  # measured drain current
R6 = r6.col("sr1_X")[_o] / I6                                               # sr1 gain 1 (device card)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 3.6))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title="run 6 raw: n=+3.2e12, D=0 (10 mT grid above 1 T)")

m6 = B6 >= 1.0  # fine-grid leg; the 50 mT leg below 1 T undersamples the 7.1 T tone below ~0.85 T
dR6 = R6[m6] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B6[m6], R6[m6], 5), B6[m6])
ax[1].plot(B6[m6], dR6, lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)", title="bg-subtracted (deg-5 in B, B >= 1 T)")

on6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I6)))
print(on6.summary())

f6, s6 = sdh_fft(R6[m6][:, None], B6[m6], bg_degree=5, log=False)
ax[2].plot(f6, s6[0] / s6[0][f6 > 4].max(), lw=0.8)
for F, lab, c in [(7.31, "ABAB light (model, n=3.2)", "tab:green"),
                  (25.78, "ABAB heavy (model)", "tab:red"),
                  (33.1, "F_L (ABCA singleton)", "k")]:
    ax[2].axvline(F, ls=":", color=c, label=lab)
ax[2].set(xlim=(0, 45), ylim=(0, 1.5), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm above 4 T)",
          title="1/B FFT, B >= 1 T")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()
print(f"T_sample {np.nanmin(r6.col('T_sample')):.3f}-{np.nanmax(r6.col('T_sample')):.3f} K; "
      f"leak max |I_tg| {np.max(np.abs(r6.col('k_2400_tg_curr')))*1e12:.0f} pA, "
      f"|I_bg| {np.max(np.abs(r6.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))*1e12:.0f} pA; "
      f"R range {R6.min():.0f}..{R6.max():.0f} Ohm at 50 uV FS ~ 5 kOhm")

**Read (run 6):** Strong, clean SdH on the electron side. Tracked tones: **7.1 T** (dominant, SNR ≈ 40, above threshold through the record's trackable low edge — onset **censored ≤ ~0.85 T**; below that the 50 mT leg undersamples it, so the true onset is unmeasured), **22.1 T** (SNR 37) and **29.5 T** (SNR 89), plus low-F censored suspects (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T — near-residual/alias candidates at the window edge, to be retired by the low-field extension and the fan).

Two readings of {7.1, 22.1, 29.5}, undecidable at a single density:
1. **ABAB constellation**: light = 7.1, heavy = 22.1, breakdown sum-tone 7.1+22.1 = 29.2 ≈ 29.5 ≈ scaled F_L. Partition 0.24/0.76 of the sum — squarely in the ABAB band (model 0.22/0.78 at n = 3.2); global scale ≈ 29.2/33.1 = 0.88, inside the lever-arm prior. The investigation's expected e-side picture, sum-tone included (ABAB inter-block breakdown is symmetry-allowed).
2. **Harmonic comb** of a single 7.1 T pocket (22.1 ≈ 3×7.1, 29.5 ≈ 4×7.1 — the tracker's flags). But a 7.1 T singleton is 0.21·F_L — it breaks the Luttinger sum at any plausible scale, so this reading requires wrong layer number or broken degeneracy.

The tracker's harmonic flag here is exactly the ratio-only trap the investigation warns about (ABAB ratio drifts through 3× with density — model heavy/light goes 6.6→3.5 over n = 1.5→3.2, measured 3.11 at 3.2). **Discriminator = n-dependence**: a harmonic tracks k·f_light exactly across the fan; a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve. That is the Landau fan's job. **Electron side is the fan side** — lower onset, higher SNR, larger F_L, and the model templates separate over the reachable window.

## Run 7 — SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0, B 10→0.3 T

Same read as run 6. Model at n = −1.2×10¹²: ABAB pair 5.86 + 6.54 T (the near-CNP close-and-balanced regime — the investigation's stated hole-side exception), ABCA singleton = F_L = 12.41 T with m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ (LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K — an ABCA pocket would be invisible here, so a hole-side null is resolvability-limited, not evidence).

# === Run 7 — sdh-spot-check, hole side: n = -1.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 10 -> 0.3 T ===
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

r7 = run(7)
_o = np.argsort(r7.col("magnet_field"))
B7 = r7.col("magnet_field")[_o]
I7 = (r7.col("sr0_X") / r7.metadata["measurement_config"]["sr0_gain"])[_o]
R7 = r7.col("sr1_X")[_o] / I7

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 3.6))
ax[0].plot(B7, R7, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title="run 7 raw: n=-1.2e12, D=0 (20 mT grid)")

m7 = B7 >= 1.0
dR7 = R7[m7] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B7[m7], R7[m7], 5), B7[m7])
ax[1].plot(B7[m7], dR7, lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)", title="bg-subtracted (deg-5 in B, B >= 1 T)")

on7 = sdh_onset(R7, B7, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I7)))
print(on7.summary())

f7, s7 = sdh_fft(R7[m7][:, None], B7[m7], bg_degree=5, log=False)
ax[2].plot(f7, s7[0] / s7[0][f7 > 3].max(), lw=0.8)
for F, lab, c in [(5.86, "ABAB pair (model, n=-1.2)", "tab:green"),
                  (6.54, None, "tab:green"),
                  (12.41, "F_L (ABCA singleton / breakdown sum)", "k")]:
    ax[2].axvline(F, ls=":", color=c, label=lab)
ax[2].set(xlim=(0, 30), ylim=(0, 1.5), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm above 3 T)",
          title="1/B FFT, B >= 1 T")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()
print(f"T_sample {np.nanmin(r7.col('T_sample')):.3f}-{np.nanmax(r7.col('T_sample')):.3f} K; "
      f"leak max |I_tg| {np.max(np.abs(r7.col('k_2400_tg_curr')))*1e12:.0f} pA, "
      f"|I_bg| {np.max(np.abs(r7.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))*1e12:.0f} pA; "
      f"R range {R7.min():.0f}..{R7.max():.0f} Ohm at 50 uV FS ~ 5 kOhm")

**Read (run 7):** Hole side is the predicted near-CNP mess. Onset 0.71 T; tone set {4.7, **6.6** (SNR 84), 8.5, 9.4 ≈ 2×4.7, **12.3** (SNR 124) ≈ F_L, 14.8, 26.2}. The model pair at n = −1.2 is 5.86/6.54 — split 0.68 T, **below this record's per-column δF ≈ 1.1 T**, so an ABAB pair would appear here as one unresolved ~6.5 T tone with intermodulation: 6.6 fits that, 12.3 ≈ F_L fits its sum/second harmonic, and {4.7, 6.6, 8.5} form a suspicious ±1.9 T comb (beat sidebands). An ABCA hole singleton (m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ) is LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K — **a hole-side null is resolvability-limited, not evidence against ABCA**. Verdict: hole side **uninformative at this density/record** (as the investigation's low-|n| exception predicts); it neither supports nor excludes any template. The fan goes on the electron side; the hole side only becomes decisive again if a later read needs it at higher |n| than the TG limit allows (it doesn't — flag as a coverage limit in the final call).

## HERA — low-field onset extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 1.0 → 0.2 T uniform-1/B

> **05:30** · onset extension of run 6: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 1.0->0.2 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.025 (161 pts), delay 0, sr1 50 uV; ends 0.2 T · **ETA ~06:00** (≈30 min)

Run 6's dominant 7.1 T tone is **censored at the record's trackable low edge** (~0.85 T — the 50 mT leg below 1 T undersamples it), so the e-side onset is a bound, not a measurement. `landau-fan` step 1: when the carrying tone is censored, pin the onset with a cheap low-field extension before committing the fan — `B_lo` is the fan's most cost-sensitive lever (the fan is ~247 B-rows at B_lo = 0.39 T; every 50 mT of unnecessary depth is ~25 rows ≈ 1 h). This run also (a) grid-change-reproduces run 6 (uniform-1/B vs uniform-B): the low-F censored suspects (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) move if they are aliases, survive if real; and (b) parks the magnet at 0.2 T, where the fan starts — no re-traverse. Grid: Δ(1/B) = 0.025 /T (4× Nyquist on the ~10 T-scale tones; the 22/29.5 T tones are dead below 1.4 T per their run-6 onsets), 161 pts. Preconditions: B ≈ 0 (handoff state), T base, V_si = 0. Ends: B = 0.2 T, gates at the e-spot. Checkpoints: first rows via the armed watch (leakage/rail/dead channel); read = `sdh_onset` on the joint run-6 + extension record.

# === sdh-spot-check, low-field onset extension of run 6: n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 1.0 -> 0.2 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) — identical to run 6's spot ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left the magnet at 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- grid: uniform in 1/B, descending 1.0 -> 0.2 T at d(1/B) = 0.025 /T (4x Nyquist on the ~10 T-scale
#     censored tones; the 22.1/29.5 T tones are dead below their 1.4/1.9 T run-6 onsets). 161 pts.
B_vec = 1.0 / np.arange(1.0, 5.0001, 0.025)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # run-6 continuity: R(B <= 1 T) ~ 50-90 Ohm at this spot
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension of run 6: n = +3.20e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 1.0 -> 0.2 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.025, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 1.0 -> 0.2 T uniform-1/B (d(1/B) = 0.025); '
              f'grid-change reproduction vs run 6 uniform-B; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)
magnet.field(1.0)        # blocking position ramp 0 -> 1 T, ~7.3 min

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# ends at 0.2 T with the gates at the e-spot — the fan starts just above; no re-traverse.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
